description: The fastest Redis client for Node.js; works with Valkey. Zero dependencies, RESP2 and RESP3, TypeScript-first.
rules: Import SolidisFeaturedClient from '@vcms-io/solidis/featured' for all 384 built-in commands; send any other command with send()
For minimal bundle size, import SolidisClient from '@vcms-io/solidis' and add only needed commands via .extend()
Solidis has zero dependencies — do not add other Redis client libraries alongside it
Commands return Promises (scan iterators are async generators) and are fully typed; prefer TypeScript strict mode
